question: Does the linked Galani ta gala katha excerpt belong to the original Malajanha film sequence?

sources.access: Original film player and Clips UI, selected paused frames only.

landmarks.match: Strong visual correspondence; not frame-exact synchronization.

sources.access: Four paused frames and displayed player timestamps independently compared with the original. Existing upload description retained for song and performer identification.
sources.limits: A visual match does not independently establish an unchanged soundtrack or identify a singing voice.

finding: Four distinctive frame correspondences establish the excerpt footage as a sequence from Malajanha. Matching original positions are 01:38:46, 01:39:20, 01:40:25 and 01:41:35. The approximate excerpt start 01:38:25 is inferred, not a directly established cut boundary.
coordinator_inspection: Viewed all four excerpt captures and selected original captures at 01:37:00, 01:39:00, 01:39:20 and 01:41:35. The seated and mat compositions correspond. No audio audition.
independent_review: Drishti inspected all four original/excerpt pairs and accepted a narrow film-identification refinement, retaining attributed song/performer metadata.

additional_search.result: No label catalogue result returned. Collector lists and download pages repeat the singer credit but do not establish an independent primary recording credit. No additional public claim adopted. Search results for a similarly titled modern novel were unrelated.

public_change: Simplify one qualified film-identification sentence and add a direct original-film scene link to the existing numbered note. No new scene interpretation or additional note.
boundaries: Printed Ga Champu quotation and its source remain unchanged.

next_action: Reconcile the verified novel, song and film findings with the existing literature and music coverage before choosing the next substantive gap. Preserve exhausted booklet, payment and exact Sadhana novel-title gaps; reopen only with an identifiable new primary source.
final_editorial_choice: One sentence refined and existing note extended; no new scene prose, note number, image or unqualified voice claim.
visual_review: Separate reviewer inspected digital pages 48,49,51,232,233 and print pages 49,50,52,234,235 plus both current browser captures. No required correction. Current source/PDF hashes and all50 source bindings verified; images, covers and maps preserved.
outcome: Matched four excerpt frames to the original Malajanha player at 01:38:46, 01:39:20, 01:40:25 and 01:41:35. Simplified one Cinema Music sentence and extended its existing source note with a direct film link; song-specific singer/composer attribution remains tied to the upload description. Both books rebuilt with unchanged 255/262 page counts and 470 notes. Separate source/content and ten-page PDF review passed; browser note and return checked. No publication.
